title: Mochizuki Honami — Let's All Get Along♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Supermarket

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Well, I'm here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I still don't know what to make for Saki and Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're bringing something for them?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Remember how they're going to be holding a songwriting camp soon?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I want to show my support by bringing something for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, good point...
I might get them something too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
But what...?
Saki and Ichika would probably like it if...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I got them some snacks...?
Something they can both munch on while working?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Do you know what you're going to bring, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I'm thinking about making dinner for them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Dinner?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm afraid that they're going to forget to eat if they get too focused on songwriting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And even if they've already eaten, they can always have what I make the next day.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see.
I think that's a great way for you to show them your support.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I plan on doing what I can for them.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Still, what should I make...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (They'll probably be feeling tired after using their brains to come up with good ideas...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, then... How about curry?
Something with a spicy kick might be just what they'll be craving.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Okay.
Curry it is.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (So, let's start looking for ingredients...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Let's see... It's been a long time, but based on the curry I had at everyone's houses...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Saki's family...
The curry they made was fairly mild.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Also, I remember them saying how it's “loaded with veggies”. They were cut into very big blocks. Hehe. I had a lot of fun that time.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Ichika's family makes theirs a little spicy.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Hehe. This is so nostalgic...
And it's interesting how each family makes their curry a little differently.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, I'm not supposed to be reminiscing right now. Let's see... What do I need...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (If I want them to both enjoy it...)

rows.Speaker: Imaginary Ichika
rows.Line: “Make it a little spicy, if you could.”

rows.Speaker: Imaginary Saki
rows.Line:
“What?! I like my curry mild!
Also, can you cut the veggies into big blocks for me♪”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Oh, they won't agree on the spice level...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Hmm... What should I do about that...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Oh, that reminds me. Grated apples...
That can help keep things mild.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Plus, apples give curry a richer flavor...)

rows.Speaker: Imaginary Ichika
rows.Line:
“Yes, please.
I like it when curry has a rich taste to it.”

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That solves that problem...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The sauce will be a little spicy, but the vegetables and grated apples should help make it mild yet flavorful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Which I'm hoping they'll both enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Let's see... What else do I need...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I want it to give them a boost of energy, then I suppose beef is the way to go?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, I'll head over to the meat section after I pick out my vegetables.

rows.Speaker: Seafood Clerk
rows.Line: Attention, customers! We are now having a limited-time sale!

rows.Speaker: Seafood Clerk
rows.Line:
All seafood is currently thirty percent off!
Please make sure to stop by!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What?! Thirty percent off?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And it all looks very fresh.
I almost feel bad receiving such a big discount...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I was thinking about buying some beef, but I can't let this opportunity slip...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, seafood curry it is...

rows.Speaker: Seafood Clerk
rows.Line:
Ah, Miss.
If it's curry that you're making, then I recommend the squid, shrimp and scallops over in this corner!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you do?
Wow, they're so big...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Just wait, Saki, Ichika...!
The seafood curry I'm about to make is going to be delicious!)
